title: How You Pay Drives What You Choose: Mental Accounting in Health Insurance Plan Choice
Institutional Dilemmas and Reform Paths of the WTO from a Sustainable Development Perspective
abstract: As the core institution of the multilateral trading system and a pivotal platform for global economic governance, the World Trade Organization (WTO) has underpinned post-war trade liberalization and institutional stability. Adopting historical review, institutional analysis and literature synthesis, this paper traces the WTO’s progression from the GATT framework to contemporary operation, clarifies its institutional structure, core functions and operational dilemmas, and systematically incorporates sustainable development into the analytical framework. The study demonstrates that the WTO is confronted with multiple crises: the paralysis of the dispute settlement mechanism, prolonged deadlock in multilateral negotiations, institutional misalignment with digital trade governance, and insufficient integration with environmental and social sustainability targets. The traditional rule-setting neglects the coordination among trade liberalization, ecological protection and inclusive development, eroding the organization’s legitimacy and effectiveness. To revitalize the multilateral trading system, targeted institutional reform is imperative: repairing the dispute settlement mechanism, adopting flexible open plurilateralism, updating digital and green trade rules, and embedding sustainable development into all core functions. By supplementing sustainable development objectives into the reform analysis, this paper enhances the logical integrity of WTO reform research and provides a theoretical reference for constructing an open, equitable and green multilateral trading framework.
abstract_zh: 作为多边贸易体制的核心制度和全球经济治理的关键平台，世界贸易组织（WTO）支撑了战后贸易自由化与制度稳定。本文采用历史回顾、制度分析和文献综合的方法，梳理了WTO从关贸总协定（GATT）框架到当代运行的演进过程，阐明了其制度结构、核心职能与运行困境，并将可持续发展系统地纳入分析框架。研究表明，WTO正面临多重危机：争端解决机制陷入瘫痪、多边谈判长期僵持、制度与数字贸易治理不相适应，以及与环境和社会可持续发展目标的整合不足。传统的规则制定忽视了贸易自由化、生态保护与包容性发展之间的协调，侵蚀了该组织的合法性与有效性。为振兴多边贸易体制，必须进行有针对性的制度改革：修复争端解决机制，采纳灵活的开放式诸边主义，更新数字与绿色贸易规则，并将可持续发展嵌入所有核心职能。通过将可持续发展目标纳入改革分析，本文增强了WTO改革研究的逻辑完整性，并为构建开放、公平和绿色的多边贸易框架提供了理论参考。

title: Heat impacts college student grades even in rich Singapore
Contests with multiplicative sabotage effect
Heat and Observed Economic Activity in the Rich Urban Tropics
abstract: We use space- and time-resolved mobility data to assess how heat impacts Singapore, a rich city state and arguably a harbinger of what is to come in the urbanising tropics. Singapore’s offices, factories, malls, buses and trains are widely air conditioned, its public schools less so. We document increased attendance and commuting to workplaces, malls and the more air-conditioned schools on hotter relative to cooler days, particularly by low-income residents with limited use of adaptive technologies at home. Investment by rich cities may attenuate heat’s pervasive negative consequences on productive outcomes, yet this may worsen the climate emergency in the long run.
abstract_zh: 我们利用时空分辨的人员流动数据，评估高温如何影响新加坡。新加坡是一个富裕的城市国家，可以说是城市化热带地区未来图景的先声。新加坡的办公室、工厂、商场、公交车和列车普遍安装了空调，而其公立学校的空调则较少。我们记录到，在较热的日子里，与较凉爽的日子相比，前往工作场所、商场以及空调较好的学校的出行人数和通勤量均有所增加，尤其是家中缺乏适应性设备的低收入居民。富裕城市的投资或许能够减轻高温对生产性结果普遍的负面影响，但从长远看，这可能会加剧气候紧急状况。

Willingness to fight on: Environmental quality in dynamic contests
abstract: We show that the prevalence of prolonged tennis contests drops sharply when the ambient environment deteriorates through heat or pollution. We develop a multi‐battle dynamic model to investigate how the disutility from a protracted competition shapes agents' willingness to fight on. Our theory predicts that a poor environment amplifies the momentum of a competitor's head start. We show how model primitives including preferences for environmental amenities can be inferred from battle‐to‐battle transition probabilities. We find that heat and pollution affect incentives to compete strategically. In a contest between equally able rivals at the median prize of $15,100, the value of a head start is $130‐370 higher in a degraded environment compared with a climate‐controlled one.
abstract_zh: 我们发现，当环境因高温或污染而恶化时，长时间网球比赛的出现频率会急剧下降。我们构建了一个多回合动态模型，以研究长时间竞争带来的负效用如何影响参与者继续争斗的意愿。我们的理论预测，恶劣的环境会放大竞争者领先优势的势头。我们展示了如何从逐回合的状态转移概率中推断出模型的基本参数，包括对环境舒适度的偏好。我们发现，高温和污染会影响策略性竞争的激励。在实力相当的对手之间、奖金中位数为15,100美元的比赛中，在退化的环境下，领先一分的价值比在气候可控的环境下高出130至370美元。

title: Within‐development density and housing prices in Singapore
Adversity-hope hypothesis: Air pollution raises lottery demand in China
abstract: The empirical literature points to a stylized phenomenon of increased demand for hope following adversity. Clotfelter and Cook (1989) suggest that hope is a key sentiment underpinning recreational gambling. Chew and Ho (1994, this journal) offer the view of hope being experienced in lottery products when people enjoy delaying the resolution of uncertainty. Taking air quality as an indicator of subjective well-being, we hypothesize a positive causal relationship between air pollution and lottery sales. We test this hypothesis using data from China and find that air pollution measured by particle concentration increases demand for a popular lottery for which province-level daily sales records exist. The relationship can readily be seen on combining high-frequency, spatially resolved lottery sales and particle pollution data. Our findings support the adversity-hope hypothesis in the context of air quality and lottery sales and point to further tests using other measures of adversity and proxies of demand for hope.
abstract_zh: 实证文献指出，逆境之后人们对希望的需求会增加，这是一种典型化事实。Clotfelter and Cook（1989）认为，希望是休闲性赌博背后的关键情绪。Chew and Ho（1994，本刊）则提出，人们在享受推迟不确定性结果消解的过程时，会在彩票产品中体验到希望。以空气质量作为主观幸福感的指标，我们假设空气污染与彩票销售之间存在正向因果关系。我们利用中国数据检验这一假设，发现以颗粒物浓度衡量的空气污染会提高一种流行彩票的需求，该彩票存在省级日销售记录。将高频、空间分辨的彩票销售数据与颗粒物污染数据结合后，这一关系可以清楚地看到。我们的发现在空气质量与彩票销售的背景下支持了“逆境—希望”假说，并指出了未来使用其他逆境度量和希望需求代理变量进行检验的方向。

Severe Air Pollution and Labor Productivity: Evidence from Industrial Towns in China
abstract:
We examine day-to-day fluctuations in worker-level output at two manufacturing sites in China. Ambient fine-particle (PM2.5) pollution is severe but significantly variable, largely due to exogenous atmospheric ventilation. We obtain an insignificant immediate output response from concurrent (same-shift) variation in particle pollution. We then allow worker outcomes to respond to day-to-day variation in pollution with up to 30 days of delay. We uncover statistically significant adverse output effects from more prolonged exposure, but effects are not large. A substantial + 10 μg/m
3
PM2.5 variation sustained over 25 days reduces daily output by 1 percent. (JEL J24, O13, P23, P25, P28, Q51, Q53)
abstract_zh: 我们考察了中国两个制造业基地工人个体产出的日常波动。周边细颗粒物（PM2.5）污染严重，但变化显著，很大程度上源于外生的大气通风条件。同一班次内颗粒物污染的同步变化，对产出没有显著的即时影响。随后，我们允许工人产出对长达30天滞后的日间污染变化作出反应。我们发现，较长时间的暴露会产生统计上显著的不利产出效应，但效应并不大。持续25天的+10 μg/m³ PM2.5大幅变化，会使日产出减少1%。（JEL J24, O13, P23, P25, P28, Q51, Q53）

Severe Air Pollution and School Absences: Longitudinal Data on Expatriates in North China
abstract: Little is known about how children of high-income expatriate families, often from rich nations, adapt to temporary residence in a severely polluted city of the developing world. We use a six-year panel of 6,500 students at three international schools in a major city in north China to estimate how fluctuation in ambient PM2.5 over the preceding fortnight impacts daily absences. Our preferred estimates are based on the exclusion restriction that absences respond to atmospheric ventilation such as thermal inversions only through ventilation's effect on particle levels.A large and rare 100 to 200 ?g/m3 shift in average PM2.5 in the prior week raises the incidence of absences by 1 percentage point, about one-quarter of the sample mean. We find stronger responses for US/Canada nationals than among Chinese nationals, and among students who generally miss school the most. Overall responses are mod-est compared to the effect on absences from more moderate in-sample variation in pollution estimated for the US using aggregate data. Using school absence patterns as a window into short-run health and behavior, our study suggests that high-income families find ways to adapt, likely by moving life indoors, even if temporary residence in north China comes at the expense of long-term health.
abstract_zh: 人们对于来自富裕国家的高收入外籍家庭子女，如何适应在发展中国家严重污染城市的暂时居住，所知甚少。我们利用华北一座大城市三所国际学校6,500名学生的六年面板数据，估计前两周周边环境PM2.5的波动如何影响每日缺勤。我们偏好的估计基于一个排他性约束：缺勤仅通过通风对颗粒物水平的影响而对逆温等大气通风条件作出反应。前一周平均PM2.5出现罕见而巨大的100至200 μg/m³变化，会使缺勤发生率上升1个百分点，约占样本均值的四分之一。我们发现，美国和加拿大籍学生的反应强于中国籍学生，且在平时缺课最多的学生中反应更为明显。总体反应相对适度，与美国基于总量数据、利用样本内较温和的污染变化所估计的缺勤效应相比，要小得多。以学生缺勤模式作为观察短期健康和行为的窗口，我们的研究表明，高收入家庭会设法适应，可能是通过将生活转入室内，即便暂时居住在华北的代价是长期健康受损。
